sunfields.name: The Sunfields
sunfields.text: A wide harshly sunlit frontier of hard earth, glassed patches, exposed metal ribs and settlements separated more by custom than by clean borders. Communities are socially distinct and often temporary; travelers carry breadth while locals carry depth. Sunforges may sit beside roads, under homes or outside town as ordinary facts nobody agrees how to interpret.

last-drop.name: The Last Drop Saloon
last-drop.text: Dusty frontier saloon and settlement social center with splintered boards, a dark rear wall, patched bar, hard white daylight at the doors and a back lot used for public punishment as readily as cargo. Marcus's authority depends on reputation, audience and everyone accepting his version of what happened. A half-buried Sunforge shape nearby is treated as ordinary shade rather than sacred machinery.

cinder-basin.name: Cinder Basin / Los Lagartos Camp
cinder-basin.text: White alkali dust, fractured basalt and patched shade structures around the exposed ribs of a half-buried Sunforge. Los Lagartos is an itinerant brotherhood and extended traveling community, not a military checkpoint. Meals, kinship, jokes, inherited obligations and a succession dispute organize the space more than terrain or machinery.

mirage-club.name: The Mirage Club
mirage-club.text: Subterranean frontier cabaret and refuge of oxidized copper, dark wood, old mirrors, small performance spaces and private back rooms. Its central social rule is NO NAMES BELOW: patrons may leave outside identities at the stairs. Isabelle's decision to call Kael 'Merrit' therefore breaks a community norm before it becomes a personal confrontation.

relay-station.name: Relay Settlement
relay-station.text: A worn frontier settlement gathered beneath an old relay tower, used as neutral ground by travelers, families and people waiting to meet someone. Message boards, communal tables, sleeping corners and side rooms matter more than the surviving equipment. The relay infrastructure is background texture, not a technical problem to solve.
